purpose: Verify selected H200 checkpoints by CPU inference and evaluate frozen CPU-pilot checkpoints on the exact same new H200 test set.
data_reconstruction: Rasterize all explicit provenance cuboid bounds; check every scene and ordered dataset hash. Regenerate nominal RF using declared noise seeds; verify operator and observation SHA256 where recorded.
checkpoint_policy: All selected checkpoints are frozen. Safe torch.load(weights_only=True). No training, weight update, test-based selection, or threshold retuning.
threshold_policy: Each version retains its own original validation-selected threshold for each model and observation prefix.
h200_replay_cells: nominal, both layouts, prefixes 3/6/12, seeds 7/11, geometry and geometry_rf (24 cells)
old_new_comparison_cells: nominal, height_diverse, prefixes 3/6/12, seeds 7/11, geometry and geometry_rf (12 paired cells)
comparison_interpretation: Paired comparison of frozen training recipes. Data volume, width, update budget and execution platform changed together; not an isolated causal effect of any one factor.
hard_metric_policy: Report every scene-level IoU difference. Near-threshold floating-point decisions may affect hard IoU; no claim of bitwise cross-platform prediction replay.

bootstrap.scope: Conditional on these fixed trained checkpoints; no estimate of training-seed population uncertainty.
